grain: mixed: program for MinESCS/HESC; subprogram for MIC/MinHTI
filters_or_mappings: MinESCS/HESC allocation and spending: state_body contains 'կրթ' AND program_code == '1162'; take program_total from BUDGET_LAW and program_actual from SPENDING files.

MIC/MinHTI allocation continuity: 2019 BUDGET_LAW uses state_body contains 'պաշտպան', program_code == '1119', subprogram_code == '11001'; 2020-2023 BUDGET_LAW uses state_body contains 'բարձր տեխնոլոգիական', program_code == '1119', subprogram_code == '11001'; 2024-2026 BUDGET_LAW uses state_body contains 'բարձր տեխնոլոգիական', program_code == '1220', subprogram_code == '11001'.

MIC/MinHTI spending continuity: 2019-2023 spending uses state_body contains 'բարձր տեխնոլոգիական', program_code == '1119', subprogram_code == '11001'; 2024-2025 spending uses state_body contains 'բարձր տեխնոլոգիական', program_code == '1220', subprogram_code == '11001'.
The combined R&D topic is a manual mapping layer over parsed budget facts, following the repo's own R&D example logic.
display_units: chart labels use billions of AMD; source CSV values remain in thousand AMD
caveats: 2019 includes an institutional transition: the budget-side MIC continuity row is under the defense ministry, while the spending-side row appears under the high-tech ministry.
2019-2024 spending is full-year actual from SPENDING_Q1234.
2025 spending is partial-year actual from SPENDING_Q123 and is intentionally shown as mixed-horizon against the annual budget allocation.
2026 budget data is included from BUDGET_LAW, while spending remains unavailable because no parsed 2026 spending file exists.
